/--
The notation typeclass for inverses.
This enables the notation `a⁻¹ : α` where `a : α`.
-/
class Inv (α : Type u) where
  /-- `a⁻¹` computes the inverse of `a`.
  The meaning of this notation is type-dependent. -/
  inv : α → α
